صَلَّالٌ Clay that makes a sound like as does new pottery; as also ↓ مِصْلَالٌ . (S, O.) ―
-b2- And رَجُلٌ صَلَّالٌ مِنَ الظَّمَأِ [A man making a rumbling sound to be heard from his belly in consequence of being thirsty: see 1]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, (K,) i. e. like شَدَّادٌ, (TA,) or ↓ صُلَّالٌ , (so in a copy of the M,) Water altered for the worse in taste and colour. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
